about: The Wilderness God Wars Dungeon (Wilderness step W6.3): the followers of Armadyl, Bandos, Saradomin and Zamorak in its main cavern, and the boulder in its empty cavern, where the OSRS Wiki's locations maps pin them (read 2026-11-15). Wander ranges are guessed until recorded. Not built: the followers fighting each other.

spawns.source: OSRS Wiki, Boulder (Wilderness God Wars Dungeon), its map pin (3053,10165, the dungeon's level 3)
